What share of your workforce understands and uses it?

calculator.title: One individual case becomes a responsibility.
calculator.description: First, the model shows the effect over {{years}} years for one employee. It then applies the same difference to every participating employee across the workforce.
calculator.controlsHint: Results update immediately when you change an input.
calculator.monthlyContribution: Modelled monthly savings contribution per participant
calculator.modelLine: One continuous model line: constant contributions, constant return assumptions and no interruptions over the selected period.
calculator.chartAria: Modelled provision line from {{startYear}} to {{endYear}} for two comparison scenarios and contributions
calculator.assumptions: {{employees}} employees × {{participation}}% participation = {{participants}} participants. {{contribution}} fully invested model contribution over {{months}} months. Assumed gross annual returns before costs are converted into equivalent monthly returns; each contribution is invested in arrears at month-end.
calculator.disclaimer: Simplified model calculation, not a forecast or guarantee. Product costs, tax and inflation are not included. The scenarios represent neither specific products nor comparable guarantee or risk profiles.
calculator.decisionPrompt: The question is not which scenario is right. The question is whether you know the costs, return assumptions and risks of your current solution.

responsibility.title: The decision does not end when the contract is signed.
responsibility.lead: Long-term benefits need clear decisions and ongoing support.
responsibility.description: For company leaders, corporate pension is therefore more than administration. Product costs, return assumptions, participation and communication all influence what ultimately reaches the workforce in 30 years.
responsibility.position: Healio makes the impact visible without promising returns. We review existing plans and assumptions and turn long-term consequences into robust decisions.

dai.title: Putting historical long-term returns into context
dai.description: For a 30-year monthly DAX savings plan ending in 2025, the Deutsches Aktieninstitut reports 7.8% a year. Costs and tax are excluded; a DAX savings plan is not a direct comparison with a corporate pension product.

destatis.title: Retirement security remains a real task
destatis.description: Final EU-SILC 2025 results show that 19.5% of people aged 65 and over were at risk of poverty; the income reference year is 2024.

bmas.title: A model calculation remains a model
bmas.description: Germany's Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs stresses that projections in the pension insurance report are model calculations, not forecasts.

facts.title: Understand business expenses correctly

facts.title: Pension within statutory incentives

facts.title: Structure health insurance correctly

facts.title: Support qualified prevention

bavLeverage.title: EUR 676 for retirement. Around EUR 75 less current take-home pay.*
bavLeverage.netEffectExplanation: In the standard example, current take-home pay may fall by around EUR 71 to EUR 74 due to additional social-security contributions – rounded to around EUR 75.
bavLeverage.description: We separate what reaches the employee from what the company actually spends.
bavLeverage.detailsIntro: This figure is not a blanket promise. The full calculation remains open for review.
bavLeverage.shortDisclaimer: * Simplified 2026 standard model. Individual figures may vary; not a forecast or guarantee.
bavLeverage.splitTitle: In the standard model, the EUR 676 consists of two parts:
bavLeverage.splitFree: EUR 338 exempt from tax and social-security contributions
bavLeverage.splitLiable: EUR 338 tax-free and generally subject to social-security contributions
bavLeverage.legalSource: Legal basis and assumptions in the calculator
bavLeverage.employerCost: Employer social-security contributions may apply to the generally liable portion in addition to the pension contribution. In the standard model this is around EUR 71 extra, bringing total cost to around EUR 747 per participant and month.
bavLeverage.historicalContext: Historical context: MSCI World USD Net Return, July 2011 to July 2026, as at July 31, 2026: 11.10% p.a. Mathematically 9.10% p.a. after the same cost assumption.
bavLeverage.disclaimer: * Simplified standard model for 2026. Potential net impact and employer cost depend on salary, contribution ceilings, health insurer and long-term-care insurance status, among other factors. Return figures are model assumptions or historical context, not a forecast or guarantee. No net pension is promised.

faq.title: What companies want to know first.
faq.description: The essential answers — clear, open-ended and without hiding the fine print.

items.question: Do existing contracts have to be replaced?
items.answer: No. The benefits review starts with an open assessment. Sound solutions remain in place; changes are made only where costs, impact, processes or communication can be improved transparently.

items.question: How do we know whether our current solution is genuinely good?
items.answer: Not from the contribution alone. Costs, scope, return and guarantee assumptions, participation, employee understanding and ongoing administration all matter.

items.question: What does Healio handle after the rollout?
items.answer: Healio remains the central point of contact, coordinates providers and communication, supports employees with questions and reviews whether circumstances or action required have changed.

items.question: What if an employer-funded benefit budget is not available yet?
items.answer: The company can voluntarily point employees to the free KassenBoost comparison. Employees use it privately and without contact details; individual inputs and results are shared with neither the employer nor Healio. A later, separate decision to seek advice or choose a solution may involve costs.

sources.title: The primary sources behind the 2026 model.

msci.description: The MSCI factsheet dated July 31, 2026 shows cumulative growth from 100 to 484.83 between July 2011 and July 2026. This equals a calculated 11.10% p.a. in USD; after a flat 2-percentage-point cost assumption it would be 9.10%. MSCI Net Return is an index methodology reflecting assumed withholding tax on dividends, not performance after individual product costs. Historical context, not a future guarantee.

msciEur.description: The official EUR net-return series shows how period, currency and return variant can materially change the outcome.

bafin.description: For unit-linked contracts with a 30-year term and monthly contributions, the weighted average among the surveyed best-selling products was a 1.90 percentage-point effective cost; the median was 1.64.

drv.publisher: German Pension Insurance · pension funding limits
drv.description: German Pension Insurance confirms for 2026 employer contributions through a pension fund, pension scheme or direct insurance: up to EUR 8,112 a year tax-free, of which up to EUR 4,056 a year is exempt from social-security contributions.

federalGovernment.description: The official 2026 monthly figures are EUR 8,450 for the pension and unemployment contribution ceiling, EUR 5,812.50 for the health and long-term care ceiling, and EUR 6,450 for the general annual income threshold.

bmgHealth.publisher: Federal Ministry of Health · statutory health insurance
bmgHealth.description: For 2026, the Federal Ministry of Health states a 14.6% general statutory health-insurance rate and a 2.9% average additional contribution; the individual insurer's rate may differ.

bmgCare.publisher: Federal Ministry of Health · long-term care insurance
bmgCare.description: The Federal Ministry of Health states a 3.6% general contribution rate for social long-term care insurance. The allocation can vary by number of children, age and place of employment.

disclaimers.assumptions: Standard social-charge assumption: statutory health insurance, 2.9% average additional contribution, one child and employment outside Saxony.
disclaimers.legalFramework: For the first employment relationship, the model assumes an eligible implementation route under Section 3 no. 63 EStG: pension fund, pension scheme or direct insurance. It assumes that the 2026 annual limits of EUR 8,112 tax-free and EUR 4,056 exempt from social-security contributions have not been used by other contributions and that twelve equal monthly contributions are paid. EUR 676 and EUR 338 are the monthly amounts derived from those annual limits.
disclaimers.projection: Simplified model calculation, not a forecast or guarantee. The selected simplified return reduction is included; actual tariff costs and their effect are not fully represented without product documents. Tax, inflation and health and long-term-care contributions in the benefit phase are not included. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.
disclaimers.payroll: Average gross salary is only a planning approximation. Contribution ceilings, health insurer, care-insurance status, place of employment and further levies must be reviewed in payroll for every employee and payroll month. This is not tax or legal advice.
